description: Land Acquisition - Nakulugamuwa, Beliattha D/S Division, Hambanthota District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a declaration by the Minister for a specific land parcel in Nakulugamuwa village, including detailed descriptions of the land boundaries, extent (0.2023 Hectare), and location details. The content focuses entirely on land matters (acquisition for public purpose) rather than government personnel changes or structural modifications, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4).
